# A Better Smile Dentist Sydney

> Comprehensive dental clinic in Sydney offering cosmetic, restorative, and surgical dentistry services with experienced practitioners and flexible payment options.

A Better Smile Dentist Sydney operates multiple locations across Sydney CBD and surrounding areas, providing a full range of dental treatments from routine hygiene to advanced implant surgery and cosmetic procedures. The clinic features an in-house dental laboratory and a team of specialist dentists including Dr Joel Kligman and Dr Navas.

## Key Topics

- Cosmetic dentistry
- Dental implants
- Invisalign clear aligners
- Teeth whitening
- Porcelain veneers
- Orthodontics
- Dental crowns
- Emergency dentistry
- Periodontal surgery
- All-on-4 implants
- Sydney CBD locations
- Dr Joel Kligman
- Flexible payment plans
- Patient transformations
- Dental hygiene
